#ifndef OV007_TWEEN_H
#define OV007_TWEEN_H

#include "types.h"

/* Reconstructed layout and name, not recovered class identity. A scalar tween
 * that drives one s32 through `out`: pk_func_ov007_020c908c allocates the 0x1c
 * bytes and binds `out`, pk_func_ov007_020c90f8 clears the first four fields, and
 * pk_func_ov007_020c8f98 updates it once per frame. The 0x2c-byte vector tween
 * that pk_func_ov007_020c8f64 allocates (updated by func_ov007_020c8de0) shares
 * this prefix through pk_func_ov007_020c90f8 and pk_func_ov007_020c90c0. */
typedef struct Ov007Tween {
    s32 state; /* 0x00 -- 0 idle (c90f8); callers set 1 to start; c90c0 and c8f98's
                *         mode 1 set 2 on arrival; c8f98 turns 2 into 3 and returns 1 */
    s32 mode;  /* 0x04 -- c8f98: 0 blends from->to by t, 1 steps *out toward `to` */
    s32 step;  /* 0x08 -- mode 0: c90c0 adds it to t; mode 1: c8f98's largest move */
    s16 t;     /* 0x0c -- mode 0 blend fraction, 0..0x1000; c90c0 clamps at 0x1000 */
    Ptr<s32> out;  /* 0x10 -- c908c binds it; c8f98 writes the tweened value through it */
    s32 from;  /* 0x14 -- mode 0 start value; callers also seed *out with it */
    s32 to;    /* 0x18 -- target: mode 0 end value, mode 1 destination */
} Ov007Tween;

typedef char Ov007Tween_size_must_be_0x1c[sizeof(Ov007Tween) == 0x1c ? 1 : -1];

#endif

#ifndef OV007_TOUCH_H
#define OV007_TOUCH_H

#include "types.h"

/* Reconstructed layouts and names, not recovered class identity.
 *
 * Ov007TouchSample is one stylus reading in the shape pk_func_0205efc0 fills
 * (the SDK's x/y/touch/validity record): pk_func_ov007_020c1db0 patches an axis
 * from the previous frame when validity bit 0 (x) or bit 1 (y) is set. */
typedef struct Ov007TouchSample {
    u16 x;        /* 0x0 */
    u16 y;        /* 0x2 */
    u16 touch;    /* 0x4: nonzero while the stylus is down */
    u16 validity; /* 0x6: bit 0 x invalid, bit 1 y invalid */
} Ov007TouchSample;

/* The 0x44-byte touch-panel record pk_func_ov007_020c2068 allocates (cleared by
 * pk_func_ov007_020c2024), stored at the ov007 manager's +0x50 and updated once
 * a frame by pk_func_ov007_020c1db0. Every role below is from c1db0's own
 * reads and writes. */
typedef struct Ov007Touch {
    Ov007TouchSample raw;      /* 0x00: this frame's reading, before patching */
    Ov007TouchSample cur;      /* 0x08: raw with invalid axes patched */
    Ov007TouchSample prev;     /* 0x10: last frame's cur */
    Ov007TouchSample lastDown; /* 0x18: the latest cur with the stylus down */
    u32 heldFrames;            /* 0x20: 0 on the press frame, +1 per held frame */
    u32 releasedFrames;        /* 0x24: 0 on the release frame, +1 per idle frame */
    s32 countdown;             /* 0x28: c1db0 counts it down to 0 every frame */
    u32 flags;                 /* 0x2c: bit 0: c1db0 reports the stylus up until it lifts */
    u16 pressX;                /* 0x30: cur.x on the press frame */
    u16 pressY;                /* 0x32 */
    u16 releaseX;              /* 0x34: cur.x on the release frame */
    u16 releaseY;              /* 0x36 */
    s16 dragX;                 /* 0x38: cur - press while held */
    s16 dragY;                 /* 0x3a */
    s16 deltaX;                /* 0x3c: cur - prev while held */
    s16 deltaY;                /* 0x3e */
    s32 pad_40;                /* 0x40: -1 at init and on each press; no reader found */
} Ov007Touch;

typedef char Ov007Touch_size_must_be_0x44[sizeof(Ov007Touch) == 0x44 ? 1 : -1];

#endif

#ifndef OV007_SPRITE_H
#define OV007_SPRITE_H

#include "types.h"

/* Reconstructed layout and name, not recovered class identity (no RTTI, no
 * vtable; plain C helpers). The 0x88-byte screen-space textured quad that
 * pk_func_ov007_020c44e4 allocates and initialises and func_ov007_020c44c4 frees.
 * Field roles come from its readers: func_ov007_020c4388 (screen -> world),
 * func_ov007_020c43bc (world size), func_ov007_020c42f8 (transform),
 * func_ov007_020c421c (draw + drop shadow) and func_ov007_020c4684 (quad). */
typedef struct Ov007Sprite {
    s32 drawFlags;   /* 0x00: c4684: 1|2 plain quad, 2 corner colours; c421c: 4 shadow; 8 tilemap */
    s32 screenX;     /* 0x04: c4388 -> func_ov007_020bfe4c centres it on 0x80000 (128 px) */
    s32 screenY;     /* 0x08: c4388 -> func_ov007_020bfe4c centres it on 0x60000 (96 px) */
    u16 width;       /* 0x0c: pixels; c43bc scales it, c4684 uses it as the texel width */
    u16 height;      /* 0x0e */
    s32 depth;       /* 0x10: c4388 view z; c43bc scales width/height by |depth| */
    Vector3 pos;     /* 0x14: c4388 writes the world position, c42f8 translates by it */
    s32 worldWidth;  /* 0x20: c43bc result; c4684 quad width */
    s32 worldHeight; /* 0x24 */
    Vector3 posOffset;   /* 0x28: c42f8 adds it to pos */
    u16 rotX;            /* 0x34: c42f8 rotation angles */
    u16 rotY;            /* 0x36 */
    u16 rotZ;            /* 0x38 */
    char pad_3a[2];      /* 0x3a */
    s32 scaleX;          /* 0x3c: c42f8 MTX_SCALE */
    s32 scaleY;          /* 0x40 */
    u16 color;           /* 0x44: c421c -> c4684 COLOR */
    u16 cornerColors[4]; /* 0x46: c4684 per-vertex COLOR when drawFlags & 2 */
    u8 polygonId;        /* 0x4e: c421c -> c4684 POLYGON_ATTR bits 24-29 */
    char pad_4f;         /* 0x4f */
    s32 alpha;           /* 0x50: Q12; c421c passes (alpha >> 12) & 0xff as POLYGON_ATTR alpha */
    s32 polygonAttr;     /* 0x54: c4684 ORs it into POLYGON_ATTR */
    u16 frameCount;      /* 0x58: c44e4 sizes frames[] by it */
    u16 frame;           /* 0x5a: c4684 draws frames[frame] */
    Ptr<Ptr<void>> frames;       /* 0x5c: texture records (mgr textures[] entries) */
    u16 repeatU;         /* 0x60: c4684 texture repeat count; 1 means use width */
    u16 repeatV;         /* 0x62: 1 means use height */
    s32 texRepeat;       /* 0x64: func_ov007_020c1448 `repeat` */
    s32 texFlip;         /* 0x68: func_ov007_020c1448 `flip` */
    s32 texColor0;       /* 0x6c: func_ov007_020c1448 `color0` */
    s16 texS;            /* 0x70: c4684 texel origin */
    s16 texT;            /* 0x72 */
    s32 shadowScaleX;    /* 0x74: c421c second, black, offset pass: medium-confidence "shadow" */
    s32 shadowScaleY;    /* 0x78 */
    u8 shadowAlphaDrop;  /* 0x7c: subtracted from the alpha for the shadow pass */
    u8 shadowPolygonId;  /* 0x7d */
    s16 shadowOffset[3]; /* 0x7e: c421c passes it as the shadow pass's vector */
    Ptr<u16> tilemap;        /* 0x84: c4684 tile map when drawFlags & 8 */
} Ov007Sprite;

typedef char Ov007Sprite_size_must_be_0x88[sizeof(Ov007Sprite) == 0x88 ? 1 : -1];

#endif
